name: Victor Marx
desc: American Christian evangelist, motivational speaker and humanitarian (born 1965)
summary: Victor Marx (born July 5, 1965) is an American author, minister, Marine Corps veteran, and political candidate. He was the Republican nominee for governor of Colorado in the 2026 election, where he faced the Democratic nominee Phil Weiser. Marx has made several claims about his life and background that have been seen as sensational and controversial, while the validity of many of his claims has been questioned or disproven.
